description: Injects a chaos HTTP status into all matching requests, then returns a structured verdict: did the app show a fallback UI, were there unhandled JS exceptions, and did it survive? Use to answer: is the app chaos-resilient — does it show a recovery UI without throwing exceptions?

expected_fallback_selector.description: CSS selector for the fallback/error UI expected to appear (e.g., '.error-boundary'). chaos_survived is true only when this is found AND there are no unhandled exceptions.

http_status.description: HTTP error status to return for all matching requests (default: 500)

intercept_pattern.description: Glob pattern for requests to fail (e.g., '**/api/**')

url.description: URL of the page to test

wait_ms.description: Milliseconds to wait after navigation before evaluating verdict (default: 2000)

name: assert_chaos_handled
